units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 69:8">Gen. R. s. 69</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Genesis 28:12">Gen. XXVIII, 12</cite>) <he>הסולם הזה … ושִׁיפּוּעוֹ וכ׳</he> that ladder stood on the Temple site, and its slant reached &c.; Yalk. ib. 120. Y. B. Bath. VII, end, 15ᵈ <he>היה עשוי … או ממקום שיפועו מודד</he> if a field has the shape of a chair, is the measuring to begin where the vertical wall begins, or where the slope begins? Ohol. VII, 2 <he>כלים שתחת הש׳</he> vessels which lie under the slope (of a tent, v. <cite ref="U01015"><he>שִׁיפּוּל</he></cite>).

<cite ref="Eruvin 102a:4">Erub. 102ᵃ</cite> sq.; <cite ref="Shabbat 138b:2">Sabb. 138ᵇ</cite> <he>שאין בשִׁיפּוּעָהּ טפח</he> when the slanting portion of a tent cover is not so large as a handbreadth, opp. to <cite ref="C00148"><he>גג</he></cite> the horizontal part; a. e.—Pl. <he>שִׁיפּוּעִין</he>, <cite ref="U01011"><he>שִׁפּ׳</he></cite>.
Ib.; Ohol. l. c. שִׁיפּוּעֵי אהלים the slanting and flat portions of tent covers; a. e.—2) overflow, over-measure.— Pl. as ab.
<cite ref="Tosefta Bava Batra 5:4">Tosef. B. Bath. V, 4</cite> <he>המוכר … כל הש׳ וכ׳</he> if one sells wine by the vessel, all the overflow belongs to the seller.
